correctness.rationale: For each alpha<-1 the mean-centered n-scale limit is the L2 martingale series sum_{j>=2}p_j xi_j, variance sum_{j>=3}p_j^2v_j; innovations are orthogonal and v_{j+1}=(1-p_j^2)v_j+p_j(1-p_j). For t=-alpha→∞, p_j=j^-t(1+O(2^-t)) uniformly, v_j=O(2^-t), so j=3 contributes 18^-t+O(36^-t), j=4 contributes 32^-t(1+o(1)), j>=5 contributes O(50^-t). The j=3 rare Bernoulli attachment K_3=2 has probability p_2→0 and dominates variance; all j>=4 remainder has o(variance) L2, proving Z_alpha/sigma_alpha→0 in probability despite its exact unit second moment. Independently enumerated all parent vectors at n=5,6 and exponent -2,-4; finite variance agreed exactly with innovation expansion. These checks do not certify the alpha limit.
